data.gender_notes: Aadil is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Just; fair; equitable; one who upholds justice
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿādil (عادل) 'just, fair, equitable', the active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l which also gives ʿadl 'justice'. A common Muslim male given name. Aadil therefore means “Just; fair; equitable; one who upholds justice”. Arabic active participle ʿādil 'just, fair'; from the root ʿ-d-l (justice).
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadil expresses “Just, Fair, Upright”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿādil (عادل) 'just, fair, equitable', the active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l which also gives ʿadl 'justice'. A common Muslim male given name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadil total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: What is the root of the name Aadil?
faq.a: Aadil comes from the Arabic root ʿ-d-l (ع-د-ل), the root of ʿadl 'justice'. Aadil is its active participle, meaning 'one who acts justly, fair, equitable'.

faq.q: What does the name Aadil mean?
faq.a: Aadil means “Just; fair; equitable; one who upholds justice”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aadil come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadil?
faq.a: The root of Aadil is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadil written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadil is written عادل in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadil a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadil is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aadil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadil is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadil verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just; fair; equitable; one who upholds justice” is established by Arabic active participle ʿādil 'just, fair'; from the root ʿ-d-l (justice)..
